prose: Tonight we continue our decode of Marvel's Loki series, with the rest of Season 2, Episode 1: Ouroboros. It's a doozy with more to say about 111 and the Fool card, the divine spirit & breath of God, the ancient motif of the crucified savior, the fiction of Black Holes and spaghettification, the mystery of the letter A (Aleph, Alpha, etc.), and a whole lot more. This content will be fascinating and educational even for those who never watched the TV series that we're decoding, so don't miss out!
